mentions.name: Grim Rain
mentions.description: A multiplayer RPG with MMO-style gameplay, described as Valheim meets Old School RuneScape. Its game server is designed to be self-hostable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a multiplayer RPG https://grimrain.com - calling it an MMO is quite bold, but the gameplay fits that genre. The game server is designed to be self-hostable too, so it's like Valheim meets OSRS
mentions.author: k4tsu
